values.note: Huron County Parks: electric only $42 a night, electric only lakeview $45, full hookup $50; rustic $31 (left out of the base); camper cabin $112; each +$5 on holidays and -$5 in the off season. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). $15 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Full Hookup $50 per night'; 'Electric Only $42'; 'Electric Only Lakeview $45'; 'Rustic $31'; 'Camper Cabin $112'; '+ $5 Holidays -$5 Off Season Discount'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Open May 1 - October 15') + https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-park-reservations ('Park Open May 1 - Oct 15'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Full Hookup' sites) + park map (legend 'Full Hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Counted on the park map (rev. 1/24): 50 full-hookup sites (24-72 and 61A), 23 electric-only sites (1-23, those on the shore side of Huron Street marked 'lake view'), 20 rustic sites (3-10 on the shore, 1-2 by the cabins, 101-110 in the rustic area), plus 6 camper cabins. Tents not allowed on full-hookup or cabin sites; one camping unit per site.

sites.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/wp-content/uploads/Stafford-Park-Map-2024.pdf (site numbers by type) + https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Tents are not allowed on Full Hookup sites or Cabin sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Free showers. Wi-Fi only at designated hotspots, not at the sites.

facilities.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Bath houses with free showers and flush toilets are available'; Wi-Fi 'only designated hotspot areas - not at individual campsites') + park map ('Dumping Station', 'Potable Water Station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through Huron County Parks' Checkfront page or by phone (888-265-2583). The next season opens to the public around December 1 (2026 season: Dec 1, 2025, noon). Refunds only 30+ days out and not for holidays or special events. Seasonal sites offered too.

booking.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-park-reservations ('2026 Reservations Open to the General Public on Monday, Dec. 1 at 12pm (Noon) EST'; Checkfront 'Book a Site') + https://huroncountyparks.com/stafford-county-park ('Reservations and Booking Assistance (888) 265-2583'), read 2026-10-22

note: Huron County Parks (county government) campground, 4451 W Huron St, Port Hope (MI thumb, on Lake Huron), with a boat ramp, ball field and tennis courts; the beach is rocky, not good for swimming. Sells out on holidays. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county's pages: electric $42 (base), lakeview electric $45, full hookup $50 (rustic $31 left out), season May 1-Oct 15, water/sewer, free showers, reservable online; park manager phone (989) 428-4213 matches. Site count 73 -> 93 (counted on the park map: 50 full hookup, 23 electric, 20 rustic) plus 6 cabins. Added Checkfront url, Dec 1 booking opening, flush toilets, dump, potable water, Wi-Fi at hotspots. Amperage not stated. Note cleaned of site/season/booking text the fields hold. Seasonal sites exist ('Seasonal Camping' section); their share is not stated.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim): the county calls its best RV sites 'Electric Only Lakeview' (map: 'Lake view sites, electric only', across Huron Street's shore side); only the rustic sites 3-10 sit directly on the shore on the map. The entry is 'lakefront'.
